title: TradeObjective
description: Phase 23 entry point. A declarative, versioned trade objective. It selects the KPI, the validation style, and which model families are eligible; it NEVER encodes a model choice. Generalizes the legacy config.yaml `program objectives` / `success thresholds` / `labels` block. Every experiment bundle and Stage-0 artifact references this objective_id (top of the provenance chain).

objective_id.description: Stable ID encoding instrument and threshold, e.g. 'nq-50pt'. Changes only on ADR-level decisions.

description.description: Plain-English statement of the trading goal.

traded products.description: Instruments the objective concerns. Exactly one should have role 'primary'. Warm-start traits (asset_class / strategy / horizon) for Stage-0 artifacts are DERIVED from the primary product + strategy_keywords + horizon.

security_type.description: e.g. futures, equity, option, etf, index.

asset_class.description: e.g. equity_futures, equities, fx, crypto, rates.

role.description: primary = the traded instrument; related = context/cross-asset.

note.description: Free-text documentation only -- must never affect objective identity.

economic_intent.description: Topology-neutral statement of the durable economic goal, independent of which metric ranks candidates during search (kpi.primary is a ranking-metric DEFAULT, not this). Optional: existing objectives predate this field and are not required to state it. Extend the enum -- do not invent free text -- when a second intent is genuinely needed.

data_availability.description: Optional HARD scoping constraint on what data can be sourced. Surfaced verbatim to the scoping agents + critic. When present, agents must NOT propose features/models that depend on anything listed as unavailable, and the critic must force a redesign onto available data.

horizon.description: Trade horizon. Only the OUTER bound is an objective constraint; the exact label windows/timestep the model uses are a modeling choice left to the search.

max_trade_horizon.description: Maximum forward window in which the qualifying move must occur, e.g. '10m'.

session.description: Two distinct session windows: (a) training_start/training_end bound the data range used by the feature engine + labels + training. (b) trading_start/trading_end bound the actual trade-execution window used by the live paper engine, the backtest engine and the webui blotter. The feature timestep is a modeling choice left to the search, not an objective constraint.

trading_start.description: Trade-execution window start (local time), e.g. '08:30'. Live + backtest ignore signals before this.

trading_end.description: Trade-execution window end (local time), e.g. '14:45'. Live + backtest flatten / block new entries at this time.

flatten.description: Local time all positions are closed; truncates every outcome path.

decision_grid_seconds.description: Decision cadence. Sampling/attempt frequency, not the underlying trading problem -- a 5s vs 15s cadence does not by itself require a new objective_id.

labels.description: Ground-truth definition of a qualifying move (WHAT counts as a signal). Immutable for a given objective_id. The label ENCODING (class scheme, forward windows, timestep) is a modeling choice left to the search — deliberately not fixed here. scheme candidate_exit_surface is the historical candidate-grid objective: it has no single move_threshold or stop_rule.

entry.description: How a decision becomes a position. market: fill at the decision price. limit: rest at the far edge of the containing bound; an unfilled order emits no row.

mae_tolerance.description: Maximum adverse excursion against entry, in `unit`.

stop_rule.description: Target-adaptive stop: stop = min(ratio_to_target * target, max). Use INSTEAD of mae_tolerance when no single adverse bound is true for every target.

unit_definition.description: What one `unit` IS when it is not a plain price unit (e.g. how R is measured). Free text, OR -- when the definition is genuinely a prior-session lookback-median, as Track C's R is -- the structured, machine-checkable form below (added for Track C; no existing objective used this key before).

source.description: The lookback rule. One form defined so far: the median of a per-session statistic over the N most recently COMPLETED sessions before the current one.

excludes_current_session.description: Must be true for this form: the current (in-progress) session contributes NOTHING to the yardstick, so it needs no future data and is trivially causal.

per_session_metric.description: How ONE completed session's own contribution to the yardstick is computed. median_print_block_range is session_r_from_tape (print tape). median_1s_block_range is path_labels.session_r on the 1s high/low grid.

per_session_block_seconds.description: Non-overlapping block width, in seconds, underlying per_session_metric.

window_end.description: Local time the per-session range window ends. Omit when the window ends at trading_end. The first-passage builder sets PathLabelConfig.entry_end to the flatten, so its window runs until flatten.

scheme.description: Ground-truth qualifying-move semantics. 'first_passage_r': one target is reached before that target's OWN stop within the horizon, distances in R (move_threshold = smallest target taken; stop given by stop_rule, not one mae_tolerance). 'candidate_exit_surface': one row per (decision, side, target level, stop level); the learned outcome is pnl_r of that geometry, not a class. 'detection_2' (default): order-agnostic window filter — peak up-excursion >= move_threshold AND peak adverse excursion < mae_tolerance over the whole window. 'triple_barrier': path-dependent first-touch on the 5s close series. 'path_vol_normalized': join parquet_pathlabels (1s first-touch, vol-normalised barriers, usable=True gate) onto the feature index (ADR-053). 'triple_barrier_atr': first-touch with per-bar ATR multiples (move_threshold / mae_tolerance are ATR multipliers).

target_observation.description: Where a barrier touch is observed. 'print_tape': touches and their order observed on individual prints, not assigned by a tie policy; stops remain 5s closes. 'path_1s_hilo': the 1s high/low grid, with an explicit tie_policy. candle_close preserves existing behavior. candle_hilo uses 5s cs_high/cs_low. tbbo uses those lossless 5s extrema, which are aggregated from TBBO trade prints; it is equivalent to candle_hilo at the 5s label grid.

outcome.description: What a candidate-exit row records and what the model is fitted on. Used by scheme candidate_exit_surface.

candidates.description: How target and stop levels are proposed. Not a single move_threshold or stop_rule.

entry_rule.description: Resting-order fill used when labels.entry is limit on the candidate-exit objective.

selection.description: How a fitted score becomes the book's trade. Structural rules are identity. Account size and the point value are defaults.

atr_feature.description: Column used as ATR when scheme is triple_barrier_atr (e.g. cs_atr_10m).

onset_only.description: If true, only the first bar of a consecutive TBM run is labelled directional (pop onset).

min_target_pts.description: Floor on ATR-scaled profit barrier, in NQ points.

min_stop_pts.description: Floor on ATR-scaled stop barrier, in NQ points.

encoding.description: How the scheme is presented to learners. Omit/`three_class` = {BIG_DOWN, NO_SIGNAL, BIG_UP} softmax (existing catalog contract). `dual_binary` (ADR-066) = two independent event probabilities on every decision timestamp: P(long)=P(+move_threshold before -mae_tolerance within horizon) and P(short)=P(-move_threshold before +mae_tolerance within horizon). Not P(side | directional) — that encoding was rejected in ADR-048.

fire.description: Dual-binary event cut (ADR-095). Long if p_long > p_short and p_long ≥ fire; short symmetric. Library default 0.1 (ADR-089). nq-50pt-econ-lg-st uses 0.40. 3-class dir_threshold is a different knob.

aux.description: Opt-in path-quality aux columns (ADR-084 / ADR-086). Omitted/empty = no aux heads on any family. Dual-binary LSTM only consumes these as Huber train targets; they are not KPI or serving outputs. Columns may still sit on the label parquet as a sidecar. `forward_return_*` is signed close-to-close; the short trunk trains on −z(return). `MAE_before_target_or_MFE` is parquet-only (not a Keras head).

risk_return.description: Trade-economics targets used as guardrails during champion selection. null = not yet formalized.

max_drawdown.description: Maximum acceptable drawdown (same unit as P&L, or fraction).

costs.description: Cost/slippage assumptions the evaluation contract applies to simulated trades. null = not yet set.

execution_cost_profile.description: Name of a profile in config/execution_costs.yaml. A reference, so commission/slippage/multiplier are not duplicated in the objective.

kpi.description: Success criteria. `champion_gate` (opt-in, ADR-071) = run the search champion picker. `requirement` = the bar a model must clear when the gate runs. `target` = the program goal (a flag, never a picker). Custom Test never applies the gate. When `primary` is an economics metric (net_expectancy / hit_rate / sharpe), the champion gate ranks passers by that metric (see ADR-027).

primary.description: Primary ranking metric for the champion gate among passers. Classification metrics rank by precision then dir_f1; economics metrics rank by that scalar then precision.

champion_gate.description: Opt-in champion picker for search / HPO / scoping. Requires a defined kpi.requirement (the gate). Omitted or false = do not pick a champion. Custom Test never gates (ADR-071).

tau.description: Optional confidence fire-cut (count trades with confidence >= tau). Declared in YAML — never inferred. If omitted, a precision_at_tau.tau on kpi.requirement is used; if neither is set, trades are counted on argmax up/down (no confidence cut).

requirement.description: The champion gate when champion_gate is true. Pass if the block's `any`/`all` conditions are satisfied. Must be present and non-empty when champion_gate is true.

target.description: Experimentation goal. `achieved` when the block's `any`/`all` conditions are satisfied.

eligible_model_families.description: Optional hint constraining the Stage-1 search space, e.g. ['sequence_dl', 'tree_ensemble', 'regime']. Empty/omitted = all catalogued families eligible.

eval.description: Evaluation configuration linking to the frozen contract.

hold_out.description: Pinned forward hold-out identifier / data-version hash. null until pinned in W2.

date_range.description: Optional inclusive calendar clip on the training/OOF universe. Applied inside the shared fold cache (src/search/fold_cache.py) — intersected with the parquet dir's natural extent, never expanded past it. Cache key includes the range, so switching windows invalidates cleanly.

start.description: Inclusive start date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. null = use parquet dir's earliest date.

end.description: Inclusive end date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. null = use parquet dir's latest date.

walk_forward.description: Optional expanding calendar splitter (ADR-042). When mode is expanding_calendar, Custom Test / --walk-forward-overlay uses month/week/day windows instead of equal bar-count folds.

train_uniqueness_bars.description: Keep at most one TRAIN bar per this many 5s bars (time-greedy). OOF/test is never thinned. 24 = 2 minutes. Reduces overlapping TBM label dependence.

train_onset_uniqueness.description: Keep the first TBM 50/6 onset, then skip TRAIN bars until that path hits target, stop, or time (ADR-099). Trees drop rows; LSTM keeps the sequence and zero-weights skipped bars. OOF is not thinned.

bar_stride.description: Training-matrix subsample: keep every Nth decision bar. The label file stays on the decision grid.

ensemble.description: Optional W6 ensemble-grid tuning. Omitted = defaults (max_base=4, consensus+stacking+vote, majority agreement).

max_base.description: Top-k base learners (by primary precision) to combine.

methods.description: Ensemble methods to build. Never mean-vote as champion — 'vote' is a labeled baseline only.

min_agree.description: Consensus: min members that must agree to fire. Omit = simple majority.

custom_optimization.description: Opt-in 3-class expected-cost train loss (ADR-072). true requires cost_matrix. Omitted/false = sparse categorical CE (existing path). Custom Test and search both honor this when fitting 3-class Keras / XGBoost / LightGBM heads. Does not change serving or the champion gate.

cost_matrix.description: 3x3 train-time cost table used only when custom_optimization is true. Rows = true class, columns = predicted class, labels down/flat/up. Train minimizes E[cost] = C[true] · softmax. Lower is better. Incorrect up and incorrect down should share one high value; a miss (pred flat | true dir) is a medium value; correct dir is the lowest (reward vs a correct flat).

labels.description: Must be [down, flat, up] when present.

search.description: Optional search-time config: HPO trials, per-family feature views (W4 / ADR-027), signal topology (primary+meta, W3 / ADR-027).

tune_trials.description: Optuna trials per tunable candidate. 0 = off (catalog defaults only).

max_train_rows.description: Optional cap on train rows per fold. Omit = catalog search_max_rows. 0 = no cap.

feature_views.description: Per-family named feature view (keys = catalog family names; values = FEATURE_VIEWS keys in src/models/feature_views.py). Overrides catalog defaults.

default_feature_view.description: Fallback named feature view when a family has no objective override and no catalog feature_view. Prefer sparse objective-conditioned views over the full matrix.

input.description: Feature source. path1s = ATR-normalised parquet_path1s + parquet_pathlabels (Encoder A/B). native_tf = per-timeframe native-bar stores (15s/1m/5m predictive + 1h/1d context, ADR-066). Default/omit = 5s engineered parquet.

decision_timestep.description: Shared decision-timestamp grid. Every base predicts the same horizon event at this cadence. native_tf default is 15s (finest predictive layer); 1m and 5m are valid grids when a coarser fire cadence is wanted.

entry_stride.description: path1s only: keep every Nth labelled 1s entry (5 ≈ 5s cadence).

usable_only.description: path1s only: drop usable=False sessions/rows (supervised default true).

topology.description: Signal topology. `single` (default) = one model. `primary_meta` = one primary + trade/no-trade gate. `output_meta` = N walk-forward bases then a binary gate on their outputs (optional context_view). `meta_stack` = N walk-forward bases; a binary LR learns per-base weights on their signed evidence (p_up-p_down or log-odds) and emits P(up), symmetric approve_threshold decides up/down/no-trade. `tf_oof_meta` (ADR-066) = 15s/1m/5m dual-binary bases; walk-forward OOF + 1h/1d context → P_final_long and P_final_short.

bases.description: Parallel bases. Strings = catalog family names (output_meta / meta_stack). Objects = native-timeframe dual-head bases (tf_oof_meta): family + native_tf + optional head. 15s is attention_lstm (temporal encoder on the tape); 1m and 5m are xgboost_ovr.

id.description: Stable base id used as the OOF column prefix, e.g. lstm_15s.

native_tf.description: Native bar interval of this base's feature store. 15s / 1m / 5m are the three predictive layers; 1h/1d are context only.

head.description: Omit/`dual_binary`/`ovr` = independent P_long and P_short. three_class = legacy softmax.

params.description: Merged over the family's catalog params_default for joint search (ADR-095). LSTM 15s: seq_len/epochs; 1m/5m XGB: n_estimators/max_depth/learning_rate.

context.description: 1h / 1d context joined onto the decision grid for the meta learner.

session_vp.description: Attach Globex-session VP (17:00 CT origin, POC / 70% VA + break/reclaim) on the 5m fold cache only. Not hive parquet (ADR-099).

outputs.description: Serving outputs of tf_oof_meta. Decision is LONG / SHORT / PASS from these two probabilities, not a single confidence.

family.description: Binary gate learner (e.g. logistic_regression, xgboost). Not the combo identity. For tf_oof_meta this is the dual-head meta (typically xgboost).

context_view.description: Optional named feature view joined by ts onto meta features. Omit = upstream outputs only. (output_meta only.)

approve_threshold.description: Meta P(trade) threshold to approve the proposed side. For meta_stack, symmetric: up if p>=thr, down if p<=1-thr, else flat. For tf_oof_meta, shared floor when long_threshold/short_threshold are omitted.

long_threshold.description: tf_oof_meta: fire LONG only if P_final_long >= this and P_final_long > P_final_short.

short_threshold.description: tf_oof_meta: fire SHORT only if P_final_short >= this and P_final_short > P_final_long.

min_primary_confidence.description: Ignore primary proposals below this confidence before meta training/apply. (primary_meta only.)

n_folds.description: Cross-fit folds for leakage-free meta OOF (default 5). For meta_stack / tf_oof_meta walk_forward_OOF, block 0 is warmup so effective coverage is (n_folds-1)/n_folds.

embargo_bars.description: Bars dropped on each side of a meta test block (default 0). Counted on the decision_timestep grid. Use >= label horizon to limit overlap leak.

scheme.description: meta_stack / tf_oof_meta. walk_forward_OOF (default): sequential — meta trains on all prior blocks and predicts each next block. Causally identical to live. cross_fit: 5-block time cross-fit with symmetric embargo (more data per prediction, weaker live-parity).

feature.description: meta_stack only. linear_weights (default): per-base signed score s = p_up - p_down in [-1,+1]. log_weights: s = log((p_up+eps)/(p_down+eps)) — enables Bayesian log-linear pooling.

outputs.description: tf_oof_meta meta-head names. Same as topology.outputs.

kpi_condition.description: One success condition. Classification: precision_at_tau / recall / f1 / directional_f1. Economics (ADR-027): net_expectancy / hit_rate / sharpe / max_drawdown / n_signals.

direction.description: For precision_at_tau / recall / f1. Omit precision_at_tau direction to use overall score precision.

min.description: Threshold the metric must clear (for max_drawdown use a negative floor, e.g. min: -200 with op gte).

min_signals.description: Override min directional signals for a precision_at_tau condition.

cost_row.description: One true-class row of the 3x3 cost matrix: predicted down, flat, up.

criteria_block.description: Exactly one of `any` (OR) or `all` (AND) — a non-empty list of conditions.
